晉.reason: Advance is the dictionary gloss and unifies the traditional and simplified recurring unit. Promote and increase were narrower story choices that drifted apart.

晋.reason: Advance is the dictionary gloss and the useful recurring unit across eleven descendants.

烏.reason: 烏 is a crow pictograph. Keeping the whole bird image is more useful than decomposing its black lower strokes as fire.

乌.reason: 乌 is the simplified form of the crow pictograph 烏; rook was an unjustified narrowing.

兩.reason: Two is the direct dictionary gloss and the stable concept used by the family.

两.reason: 两 is the simplified form of 兩 and means two; pair was a related but unnecessarily different gloss.

袞.reason: 袞 names an imperial robe. The adjective ceremonial was incomplete and forced vague scenes.

衮.reason: The root should match the coherent imperial-robe unit already used by its descendants.

帶.reason: 帶 is a pictograph of a woven belt. Belt is more common and direct than sash.

带.reason: 带 is the simplified form of 帶; belt is more common and direct than girdle.

evidence.supports: Advance, crow, two, imperial robe, and belt are the recorded glosses; variant links are explicit.
